categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing machinery in src/rpc/request.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance bug where malformed batch elements can inherit the previous request's ID or have error responses suppressed. As noted by reviewer pinheadmz, this resolves an edge case that 'could confuse consumers of the interface expecting unique IDs in batch responses', but since it only affects batches containing invalid non-object elements, it is reasonably deferrable.
